title: Agentic Aggregation for Parallel Scaling of Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2604.11753v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study parallel test-time scaling for long-horizon agentic tasks such as agentic search and deep research, where multiple rollouts are generated in parallel and aggregated into a final response. While such scaling has proven effective for chain-of-thought reasoning, agentic tasks pose unique challenges: trajectories are long, multi-turn, and tool-augmented, and outputs are often open-ended. Aggregating only final answers discards rich information from trajectories, while concatenating all trajectories exceeds the model's context window. To address this, we propose AggAgent, an aggregation agent that treats parallel trajectories as an environment. We equip it with lightweight tools to inspect candidate solutions and search across trajectories, enabling it to navigate and synthesize information on demand. translated_title: 面向长时程智能体任务的并行扩展的智能体聚合方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究了长时程智能体任务（如智能体搜索和深度研究）中的并行测试时扩展，其中多个轨迹并行生成并聚合为最终响应。虽然这种扩展已被证明对思维链推理有效，但智能体任务提出了独特挑战：轨迹长、多轮、工具增强，且输出通常是开放式的。仅聚合最终答案会丢弃轨迹中的丰富信息，而拼接所有轨迹则超出模型的上下文窗口。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AggAgent，一种将并行轨迹视为环境的聚合智能体。我们为其配备轻量级工具，用于检查候选解决方案并在轨迹间搜索，使其能够按需导航和综合信息。在六个基准测试和三个模型家族（GLM-4.7、Qwen3.5、MiniMax-M2.5）中，AggAgent优于所有现有聚合方法。
tldr: 本文提出AggAgent，一种将并行轨迹视为环境并配备轻量工具进行导航和综合的聚合智能体，有效解决了长时程智能体任务中并行扩展的聚合挑战，并在多个基准和模型上超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AggAgent, an aggregation agent that treats parallel trajectories as an environment with lightweight tools for navigation and synthesis, effectively addressing aggregation challenges in parallel scaling of long-horizon agentic tasks and outperforming existing methods across benchmarks and models.
